about: the Royal Rumble once its entrants have run out (2026-10-27: an eliminated CPU Superstar, no entrant for his slot, was put back in the match by the game and brawled on with everyone for good). A field of 4, so it runs out at once: every elimination after that is one with no entrant -- the fix keeps him out; the Rumble must end with a winner

expect.name: the Rumble started
expect.check: stage == 2 and mode == -2 and match_frames != 0xFFFF and match_frames > 30

expect.name: no eliminated Superstar back in the Rumble (eliminated, yet the slot's in-the-Rumble flag on and not out)
expect.check: not ((s1_elim >= 0 and (s1_e1 & 0x10) and not (s1_flags & 1) and s1_id not in (0, 0xFFFF, 1)) or (s2_elim >= 0 and (s2_e1 & 0x10) and not (s2_flags & 1) and s2_id not in (0, 0xFFFF, 1)) or (s3_elim >= 0 and (s3_e1 & 0x10) and not (s3_flags & 1) and s3_id not in (0, 0xFFFF, 1)) or (s4_elim >= 0 and (s4_e1 & 0x10) and not (s4_flags & 1) and s4_id not in (0, 0xFFFF, 1)) or (s5_elim >= 0 and (s5_e1 & 0x10) and not (s5_flags & 1) and s5_id not in (0, 0xFFFF, 1)))

expect.name: no model's matrices ever went bad
the Rumble ended (a winner: back on the championship list)
eliminated men were kept out when no entrant was due (the fix ran)
